Graphs of twin-width at most 2 have bounded mim-width

lax-528502·formalized by Édouard Bonnet @EdouardBonnet · Yeonsu Chang · GPT-6.2-Astra max·created 26 Nov 2026·GitHub @250f57f·Lean v4.33.0 epoch · mathlib db584cd6d46c

      Abstract

      Every graph of twin-width at most 222 admits a branch decomposition of mim-width at most 888. Given a 222-sequence, one can construct such a decomposition in polynomial time. This gives polynomial-time algorithms for fixed-kkk Coloring, Dominating Set, Total Dominating Set, Independent Dominating Set, Connected Dominating Set, Weighted Feedback Vertex Set, Subset Feedback Vertex Set, and Longest Induced Path.

      For t≥2t \ge 2t≥2, an nnn-vertex graph of twin-width at most 222 with no induced Kt,tK_{t,t}Kt,t​ has tree-independence number at most 84(t−1)84(t-1)84(t−1). Given a 222-sequence, a word RAM constructs a tree decomposition meeting this bound in nO(t)n^{O(t)}nO(t) time.

      When the number of colors is part of the input, Minimum Coloring is NP-complete even when a 222-sequence is supplied.
